title: Emil Kowalski launches design tools to upgrade AI-built websites #emilkowalski #aidesign
description:
Emil Kowalski and Claude Code introduced three key design skills to transform AI-built websites from generic and flat to polished and engaging. These skills include adding intentional motion with proper easing, using Impeccable's 20 commands for typography, color, spacing, and layout to refine UI instantly, and applying Taste to train Claude on high-quality, clean designs that avoid overused gradients and fonts.

These tools address a common market issue where AI-generated websites often appear uninspired and uniform due to predictable design patterns. By incorporating motion and refined design systems, developers can create interfaces that feel purposeful and contemporary without extensive manual effort.

This approach enhances productivity and elevates the quality of AI-assisted web design, making it easier to deliver professional-looking projects rapidly. It highlights a growing trend in blending AI capabilities with human design sensibilities to overcome the limitations of automated outputs.
